description: This PHP source file defines a controller class for managing a custom HTML module in an OpenCart e-commerce platform. It handles actions such as displaying the module configuration page, saving module data, adding new modules, and deleting existing modules, with proper permission checks and dynamic data loading.

classes.name: HTML
classes.description: Controller class for managing an HTML module in the OpenCart admin interface. It provides methods for rendering the configuration page, saving, adding, and deleting modules, with appropriate permission checks and data handling.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Renders the module configuration page with current module data, language support, and necessary scripts and layout components.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Processes the form submission to save or update a module, including permission checks and validation.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds a new HTML module with default name and permissions, returning success or error status.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes a specified module by module ID, with permission validation.
